Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aditya - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Meera - 13 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Kavita - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Aditya: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aditya starts crying.]

Aditya: "Yes, of course."

[Aditya smiles at Mother.]

Kavita (gently): "Oh wow!"

[Aditya gets frightened and steps back.]

Aditya: "That's easy."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[Aditya knocks on the door.]

Kavita (gently): "Careful!"

[Aditya opens the door and goes out.]

Aditya: "Yes, all right."

[Aditya slams the door shut.]

Aditya (softly): "And then?"

[Aditya opens the window.]

Aditya (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Aditya stands in the park. Meera and Kavita stand near him.]

Meera: "What a nice place."

[Aditya does push-ups.]

Aditya: "I'm ready!"

[Aditya does yoga on a mat.]

Meera: "Yes, all right."

[Meera skips rope.]

Meera (happily): "What a day to remember!"
